title: Up close: small animals, big numbers
caption:
Small bodies, ridiculous specs.

The mantis shrimp's club moves so fast it creates collapsing cavitation bubbles in the water, adding a second shock to every strike.

Source: Patek et al. 2004 (Nature), Teyssier et al. 2015 (Nature Communications), Thoen et al. 2014 (Science), National Geographic.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
